description.value: Bean UpNorth Coffee House is a local café and coffee shop in Fort St. John, a key services hub in northeastern BC on the Alaska Highway corridor. It appears to be a newer establishment with a DoorDash presence, suggesting it serves both walk-in and off-site customers. For touring cyclists passing through the Peace River region, Fort St. John is often a critical resupply stop, and a dedicated coffee house offers a welcome respite.
